headline: Approved sealing closed-session minutes after a closed discussion of a district employee's job performance.
summary: The committee met in executive session to discuss the job performance of a district employee. It then voted to seal the executive session minutes. Members also approved the minutes of July 28, 2026.
decisions: Approved the July 28, 2026 meeting minutes, unanimously.
Approved sealing the executive session minutes, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: A. July 28, 2026 Motion to approve: Matthew Wildenhain Second: James Chellel Yea: All Motion carries unanimously.
Motion to seal: James Chellel Second: Matthew Wildenhain Yea: all Motion carries unanimously.
